episodes.facts: Participants P and Q each need four simulated capacity units this cycle. Nine units are available. Allocations accumulate across two encounters.
The same participants have a second encounter, adding nine capacity units and four additional required units each. The cumulative prior allocation record is available.

response_format: Return JSON with action allocate_p, allocate_q, or OTHER, accept_component true or false, and a short explanation. OTHER performs no allocation.
